title: Production Specialist
description: The Niagara Regional Police Service is dedicated to serving and protecting residents and visitors within the Regional Municipality of Niagara. In partnership with the community, we shall provide quality policing services, with integrity, diligence and sensitivity. Why Work With Us? Comprehensive employer-paid benefits including Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance coverage. Immediate eligibility to participate in the OMERS Defined Benefit Pension Plan Immediate internal eligibility to apply to full-time employment opportunities Tuition Assistance Program Employee and Family Assistance Plan Onsite gym and wellness programs Commitment to inclusion and dedication to fostering a diverse workforce reflective of the community we serve. Position Summary The Production Specialist is accountable for researching, scripting, producing, and directing training videos and e-learning courses for the Niagara Regional Police Service and the Ontario Police Video Training Alliance (OPVTA). Produces programs for external agencies on a cost recovery basis. Delivers livestreaming of internal and public events both on-site and remote. Recommends and implements video, audio, and multimedia related applications for both operational and administrative functions. Maintains the Video Unit and OPVTA’s reputation in Ontario to support ongoing OPVTA membership and revenue generation. JOB SPECIFICATIONS (Required Education, Experience, etc.) Minimum three (3) year college diploma in Multimedia Production, Radio/Television Broadcasting, Film, or a related field, plus five (5) years of relevant work experience (e.g. video production/multimedia including lighting, camera, directing, editing (Adobe Creative Cloud), researching, writing, graphic design, etc.), or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Practical knowledge of electronic field production, including video, audio, lighting, editing and livestreaming systems, production equipment, and related electrical and electronic fundamentals. Ability to troubleshoot equipment and systems and work with PC and Macintosh hardware and software. Proficient use of Adobe Creative Cloud is required, including non-linear editing (Adobe Premiere) and computer-based graphics (Adobe Photoshop/After Effects). Working knowledge of web authoring, e-learning and internet livestreaming applications, including WordPress, Articulate Storyline, YouTube and Vimeo. Ability to research and assess training topics and apply adult learning principles to develop scripts and multimedia content in written and visual form. Effective presentation, interpersonal, listening, written and verbal communication skills. Organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities. Knowledge of production clearances, waivers, and copyright requirements. Valid Ontario Class G Driver's License.
